label: Resident population (July 1 estimate)
description: Census Bureau estimate of the resident population on July 1 of the year, summed over the counties (Puerto Rico municipios) in the district.
caveats: Districts are built from whole counties: a county is credited to the district that holds it in data/processed/boundaries/county_district.csv. Eight counties are cut by statutory carve-outs (Fort Bragg/Camp MacKall and FCI Butner -> E.D.N.C.; Yellowstone NP parts of MT and ID -> D. Wyo.); their whole population is counted in M.D.N.C., D. Mont. or D. Idaho, because Census publishes no county-part figures for these areas (see data gaps). American Samoa is in no judicial district and is excluded. Size of the effect at the 2020 Census (blocks whose internal point lies in a carve-out, carveout_blocks_2020.csv): Hoke County 8; Durham County 2,477; Gallatin County 21; Park County 13; the other split counties 0. 2000-2009 come from the 2000-2010 intercensal series, 2010-2019 from the 2010-2020 intercensal series, and 2020-2025 from the Vintage 2025 postcensal series (revised every year and replaced by intercensal estimates after the 2030 Census). Series breaks at 2010 and 2020. No annual estimates exist for Guam, the U.S. Virgin Islands or the Northern Mariana Islands, so D. Guam, D.V.I. and D.N.M.I. have no July 1 values.
formula: sum over counties assigned to the district of the county's published July 1 estimate

label: Resident population (decennial census, April 1)
description: Decennial census count of the resident population on April 1 of 2000, 2010 and 2020, summed over the counties (municipios; islands; municipalities) in the district.
caveats: Districts are built from whole counties: a county is credited to the district that holds it in data/processed/boundaries/county_district.csv. Eight counties are cut by statutory carve-outs (Fort Bragg/Camp MacKall and FCI Butner -> E.D.N.C.; Yellowstone NP parts of MT and ID -> D. Wyo.); their whole population is counted in M.D.N.C., D. Mont. or D. Idaho, because Census publishes no county-part figures for these areas (see data gaps). American Samoa is in no judicial district and is excluded. Size of the effect at the 2020 Census (blocks whose internal point lies in a carve-out, carveout_blocks_2020.csv): Hoke County 8; Durham County 2,477; Gallatin County 21; Park County 13; the other split counties 0. Counts are as first tabulated (Census 2000 Demographic Profile, 2010 Demographic Profile Summary File, 2020 P.L. 94-171 file); they do not include later Count Question Resolution corrections, so they can differ slightly from the April 1 estimates bases. Island Areas counts come from the Census Bureau's Island Areas tables.
formula: sum over counties assigned to the district of the county's published census count
